digest.component_or_area: unit tests — subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: Test test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted uses a 15-second real loopback socket serving sustained bytes above floor, consuming 15+ seconds of wall time per matrix cell; must inject 1-second low-speed window while keeping real socket and pacing semantics to complete in low single-digit seconds.

Test test_read_retried_then_terminal spawns three real child processes with production 2s/4s backoff sleeps and 1-second call timeout, consuming ~9 seconds total; must inject sub-second call/grace/drain values and replace retry sleeps with a logical schedule recorder to complete in low single-digit seconds.
All spawned PIDs in the ACLI read-retry sentinel must be polled and confirmed absent after terminal failure, proving no child or process group survives cleanup.
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt count, and backoff defaults must remain unchanged; no production code modified and no absolute wall-clock pass threshold added.
